ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) vs 25% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments occupy the majority of both lobes. A central low-intensity (black) region extends from the peduncle connection, flaring outward. Black pigmentation is concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margins, with distinct stippled transition zones between white and black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 40 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:2.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (approx. 2-5 pixels), while the left lobe shows smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges with a posterior-oriented sweep; trailing edges exhibit a slight concave curve towards the median notch and a recurved convex trajectory towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of dark, roughly circular pixel groups (mottling) on the distal section of the left lobe's white field; smaller isolated dark spots on the upper-inner section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-aligned linear grey pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy black pigmentation at both distal tips; small notch-like irregularity on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast white alphanumeric text 'NAHWC #8054 Jawa' and 'YoNAH #3000' in the bottom margin area, external to the biological subject.
